details: An incomplete self-authentication command returned usage diagnostics for missing stage/session/agent/output. It read no peer/session evidence and wrote no release; controller subsequently authenticated full reading and explicitly prohibited further self-authentication.

An owned cooked-terminal stdin receiver was interrupted with control-C and exit1 before any handoff metadata or output existed. Exact existing checked bytes were transported noninteractively in the same context; checker and holder hashes agree.
